purpose: Vorschaubild für das zweite Homepage-Video: Live at Rockpalast, 2004.
reference_roles: Identität, Alter, Körperbau, Pose, Gitarre und Konzertaufnahme
Ausschließlich fotografische Tonalität des ausgewählten ersten Video-Vorschaubilds
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: 16:9 landscape video preview image for a dark Jackie Leven tribute homepage. Produce one finished landscape image, 1672 x 941 pixels, matching the photographic tone of the second reference.
Input images: Image 1 is the original Rockpalast video screenshot and the sole reference for Jackie's identity, mature age, physical build, hair, expression, clothing, guitar, microphone and performance pose. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for neutral monochrome tonality, restrained archival photographic treatment and darkness. Do NOT borrow the younger face, hair, shirt or studio set from Image 2.
Primary request: Reinterpret Image 1 as a subtle, faithful black-and-white archival concert photograph that feels like the companion to Image 2. The mature Jackie is seated and singing into a boom microphone while playing his acoustic guitar, captured from the original slightly low camera angle. Preserve his recognizable full face, heavy cheeks and neck, substantial body, slightly tousled medium-length hair, open dark shirt with rolled sleeves and concentrated unsmiling expression. Do not slim, beautify, idealize, rejuvenate or invent a generic singer.
Composition: widescreen medium shot, Jackie near the center, guitar across the lower half, its neck extending to the right. Include the whole recognizable acoustic guitar body, neck and headstock, both anatomically natural hands in their reference playing positions, and enough space above the head. Preserve the low-angle stage presence without extreme distortion. Show only the upper portion of his seated legs as needed; extend the dark setting horizontally rather than squeezing the source or cropping the guitar. The microphone sits at his mouth with its boom coming from the upper right, as in Image 1.
Backdrop: simplify the busy concert stage into deep charcoal darkness. Keep a few soft, subdued stage-light beams behind and above Jackie as atmosphere, much dimmer and less busy than the original. The background accompanist, equipment and cables recede into indistinct peripheral shadow; no prominent second portrait. Fade the lower outer edges softly into the dark setting.
Style/medium: restrained natural concert photography with smooth continuous grey tones, gentle analogue grain, slight optical softness and real unretouched skin texture. No drawing, painterly marks, posterization, digital sharpening or artificial high-detail skin restoration.
Palette/light: neutral black, graphite and silver greys only, absolutely no sepia, brown or coloured tint. Near-black #0d0f12 outer background. Face and hands clearly readable in soft midtones; the guitar wood rendered in muted silver-grey, avoid a huge bright white guitar. Preserve detail in shadows, with restrained highlights and the quiet contrast of Image 2.
Constraints: no type, captions, watermarks, television channel emblem, new logos, border or play icon. No new objects. Prioritize the likeness and characteristic physical proportions of the man in Image 1.
